title: Kamui: Limb Removal
body:
Syntax: perform kamui limb removal <target>

Description: An interruptible 6-8 second Kamui cast that deals a major single burst if it completes. Requires an active Sharingan and this Mangekyo eye technique assigned; authenticated immortals can test every Mangekyo technique without those gates. It is not a normal level unlock. The target must be in your room; moving away before a delayed cast resolves makes it fizzle. Costs 80 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 45 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
